name: LFM2 1.2B
description: A balanced everyday model for thoughtful answers, writing, planning, and general tasks.
bestFor: Quick everyday questions, short drafts, summaries, and lightweight planning. It is a small, responsive general-purpose option for straightforward tasks; larger models may do better with complex reasoning or long instructions.

name: Qwen3 0.6B
description: A compact, fast model for everyday questions, drafts, and short planning tasks.
bestFor: Fast responses, simple explanations, short writing, and basic everyday tasks. Its compact size favors speed and a smaller download over depth on difficult, multi-step questions.

name: Qwen3 1.7B
description: A capable small reasoning model for writing, analysis, and everyday problem solving.
bestFor: More involved questions, step-by-step problem solving, analysis, and writing. It offers more capacity than the 0.6B option while remaining a relatively compact on-device model.

name: MiniCPM5 2B
description: An efficient modern model for coding, math, tool use, and capable everyday assistance.
bestFor: Coding help, mathematical problem solving, structured planning, tool-oriented prompts, and demanding everyday questions where strong capability per download byte matters more than the absolute fastest response.

name: Qwen3 4B Instruct 2507
description: A premium non-thinking Qwen model for stronger writing, analysis, coding, and instruction following.
bestFor: Complex writing, careful analysis, coding, multilingual questions, and difficult instructions where users accept a larger download and higher memory use for the catalog's strongest general text tier.

name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
description: A lightweight instruction-following model for quick, general-purpose conversations.
bestFor: Instruction following, rewriting, summaries, and general-purpose conversation. Choose it for a lightweight assistant-style model; it is text-only and does not interpret image attachments directly.

name: SmolLM3 3B
description: A stronger compact model for more involved writing, coding, and multilingual conversations.
bestFor: Longer writing, coding help, reasoning, and multilingual conversation. Its 3B size can handle more involved prompts than the smallest options, but needs a newer iPhone and more memory.

name: Gemma 3 1B Instruct
description: Google's compact instruction model for concise writing, summaries, and everyday questions.
bestFor: Concise instruction following, summaries, and general questions. This quantized 1B version is text-only, so use the separate vision model for questions about images.

name: LFM2.5 1.2B Instruct
description: A newer, efficient Liquid AI model for multilingual conversations and everyday tasks.
bestFor: Efficient everyday conversation and multilingual short-form writing. Its small footprint makes it a practical alternative for quick chats and summaries on supported iPhones.

name: Granite 3.3 2B Instruct
description: IBM's efficient instruction model for structured answers, documents, and practical tasks.
bestFor: Structured responses, practical question answering, and working with user-provided text. It is a good fit for clear, organized summaries and document-focused prompts.

name: DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 1.5B
description: A compact reasoning model for math, logic, and detailed problem solving.
bestFor: Math, logic, and multi-step reasoning. It may take longer and produce more detailed responses than a regular chat model, so it is best when careful problem solving matters more than speed.

name: Qwen2.5 Coder 3B Instruct
description: A coding-focused model for explaining, writing, and debugging software locally.
bestFor: Writing, explaining, and debugging code; useful for programming questions and snippets. It is specialized for coding rather than being the best choice for every general conversation.

name: Phi 3.5 Mini Instruct
description: Microsoft's multilingual compact model for general chat, reasoning, and lightweight coding.
bestFor: General instruction following, multilingual chat, and lightweight coding help. Its larger size can help with more involved prompts, while requiring a newer, more capable iPhone.

name: SmolVLM2 500M
description: A lightweight vision model for understanding images and answering questions about them.
bestFor: Describing attached images, recognizing visible objects and actions, and reading clear text with a smaller download. It is the preferred lightweight vision bridge for Beacon’s text-only chat models.

name: Qwen2-VL 2B
description: A compact vision-language model for understanding images and answering questions about them.
bestFor: Answering questions about attached images, describing scenes, and reading visible text. It is the catalog’s vision model; download it before retrying a chat that includes an image.

name: Qwen2.5 0.5B Instruct
description: A very small multilingual chat model for quick questions and short drafts.
bestFor: Short everyday questions, rewriting, and lightweight multilingual conversation. This small 4-bit model prioritizes a tiny download and low memory use over difficult reasoning or lengthy instructions.

name: Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct
description: A compact multilingual assistant for writing, explanations, and practical questions.
bestFor: Everyday writing, summaries, explanations, and multilingual questions. It offers more capacity than the 0.5B model while keeping its download below one gigabyte; long contexts still increase runtime memory.

name: Qwen2.5 3B Instruct
description: A larger compact Qwen assistant for more involved writing and multilingual conversation.
bestFor: Longer drafts, explanations, multilingual conversation, and general problem solving. This 3B option uses more memory than the smaller Qwen2.5 models and is best used with moderate conversation lengths on a phone.

name: Qwen2.5 Coder 0.5B Instruct
description: A tiny coding assistant for short snippets and basic programming explanations.
bestFor: Short code examples, basic syntax questions, and small edits when download size matters most. This is a coding-oriented model, not a substitute for testing generated programs or a larger model on complex debugging tasks.

name: Qwen2.5 Coder 1.5B Instruct
description: A compact programming assistant for explaining, drafting, and editing code.
bestFor: Explaining code, producing short functions, and helping with localized debugging questions. It balances a sub-gigabyte download with more capacity than the smallest coding model; always review and test its output.

name: Qwen2.5 Math 1.5B Instruct
description: A small math-focused model for equations and worked problem-solving explanations.
bestFor: Mathematical questions, algebra, and worked explanations where a specialist model is useful. Its answers can still contain mistakes; check calculations independently and use a vision model for attached images.

name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
description: Meta's larger lightweight assistant for writing, summaries, and general conversation.
bestFor: General conversation, summaries, and longer writing tasks with more capacity than Llama 3.2 1B. Its larger weights and conversation cache require more memory, so shorter contexts are preferable on lower-RAM phones.

name: Gemma 2 2B Instruct
description: A compact Google instruction model for text-only conversation and writing.
bestFor: Text-only questions, rewriting, summaries, and conversational assistance. This 4-bit Gemma 2 model has a larger memory footprint than the 1B Gemma 3 option and should be used with modest context lengths on a phone.

name: Gemma 1.1 2B Instruct
description: An earlier instruction-tuned Gemma option for text questions and short writing.
bestFor: Trying the earlier Gemma instruction model for conversation, summaries, and rewriting. Its conversion is larger than newer small Gemma options, so choose a newer or smaller model when memory efficiency matters most.

name: Gemma 3n E2B Text
description: The text-only MLX conversion of Google's effective-2B Gemma 3n model.
bestFor: Text conversation and writing using Gemma 3n's language model. E2B describes effective capacity; this conversion has about 4.46B total parameters. This language-model-only conversion does not accept images directly.

name: Phi 4 Mini Instruct
description: Microsoft's compact assistant for reasoning, writing, and programming questions.
bestFor: Instruction following, explanations, programming questions, and general reasoning. Its roughly 3.8B parameters make it one of the larger text options here; the download size does not include additional generation memory.

name: Phi 4 Mini Reasoning
description: A reasoning-focused Phi model for deliberate math and multi-step problem solving.
bestFor: Math, logic, and problems that benefit from longer reasoning. It can take more time and generate longer answers than a regular chat model, increasing both waiting time and conversation-cache memory on a phone.

name: Falcon H1 0.5B Instruct
description: A small hybrid-architecture assistant for lightweight local conversations.
bestFor: Lightweight instruction following, short drafts, and simple conversations with a small download. This hybrid Falcon model favors compactness; larger models are generally more suitable for difficult or lengthy requests.

name: Falcon H1 1.5B Instruct
description: A compact hybrid Falcon model for everyday instruction-following tasks.
bestFor: Everyday questions, summaries, and short writing using Falcon's hybrid architecture. It offers more capacity than the 0.5B option while keeping the download below one gigabyte; actual speed depends on device and prompt.

name: Falcon H1 3B Instruct
description: A larger compact Falcon assistant for more involved text conversations.
bestFor: More involved writing, explanations, and general questions using a hybrid Falcon architecture. This 3B model needs more memory than the smaller Falcon options; choose shorter conversations on phones with less RAM.

name: LFM2.5 2.6B
description: A larger Liquid AI chat model for multilingual writing and everyday assistance.
bestFor: Multilingual conversation, writing, and everyday instructions with more capacity than LFM2.5 1.2B. This larger model trades additional download and working memory for a broader text-assistant option on capable phones.

name: LFM2.5 1.2B Thinking
description: A lightweight thinking-oriented Liquid AI model for step-by-step questions.
bestFor: Trying deliberate reasoning and worked explanations with a small download. Thinking responses can be slower and longer than the regular LFM2.5 model; verify important conclusions rather than treating reasoning text as proof.

name: LFM2 2.6B
description: The larger LFM2 text model for conversation, summaries, and writing.
bestFor: Everyday conversations, drafting, and summaries with the larger original LFM2 model. It is an alternative to the newer LFM2.5 variants and uses more memory than Beacon's original LFM2 1.2B option.

name: Qwen3 4B Thinking
description: The original Qwen3 4B model with thinking support for more deliberate answers.
bestFor: Reasoning-oriented questions, mathematical explanations, and multi-step analysis. Unlike the separate Instruct 2507 model, this original Qwen3 release supports thinking; larger answers require additional time and cache memory.

name: SmolLM 135M Instruct
description: An extremely small instruction model for simple questions and experimentation.
bestFor: Very simple prompts, quick experiments, and the smallest possible model download. Its limited capacity means unreliable answers on demanding instructions, multilingual questions, or reasoning; prefer a larger model for important work.

name: SmolLM 360M Instruct
description: A tiny Hugging Face text model for basic instruction following.
bestFor: Basic text prompts, small writing experiments, and straightforward questions when memory or storage is limited. This tiny model is less capable than the 1B and larger assistants and should not be relied on for complex tasks.

name: SmolLM 1.7B Instruct
description: A small Hugging Face assistant for general text conversations and short writing.
bestFor: General text conversation, rewriting, and short summaries with the original SmolLM instruction model. It has more capacity than the 135M and 360M options while remaining smaller than SmolLM3 3B.

name: EXAONE 4.0 1.2B
description: LG AI Research's compact instruction model with Korean and English support.
bestFor: Korean and English conversation, short writing, and everyday instructions with a compact download. Review the upstream EXAONE model license before use; its small size does not guarantee accuracy on difficult reasoning tasks.

name: Gemma 4 E2B Instruct
description: Google's effective-2B multimodal model for text and image questions.
recommendedDevice: 12 GB RAM or more; memory warning
bestFor: Text and image questions with Gemma 4. E2B is an effective-capacity label: this conversion contains about 5.1B total parameters and a roughly 3.6 GB download. It is a demanding option, not a guaranteed fit for a 6 GB phone.

name: Gemma 3 4B Instruct
description: A multimodal Gemma option for writing and understanding attached photos.
bestFor: Writing and questions about images with Gemma 3's larger multimodal model. Its image encoder adds to the language model's memory needs; the full conversion is substantially larger than the text-only Gemma 3 1B model.

name: Qwen3.5 0.8B
description: A small multimodal Qwen model for text chat and lightweight image understanding.
bestFor: Compact text conversations and basic questions about attached images. This is the small Qwen3.5 multimodal conversion; image processing and longer contexts still require working memory beyond its modest download size.

name: Qwen3.5 2B
description: A compact multimodal assistant for everyday text and image questions.
bestFor: Everyday conversation, explanations, and questions about images with more capacity than Qwen3.5 0.8B. It combines language and vision components, so generation and image encoding require additional memory beyond the weights.

name: Qwen3.5 4B
description: A larger Qwen3.5 multimodal option for more demanding text and image tasks.
bestFor: More involved writing, explanations, and image questions using Qwen3.5. This roughly 3 GB multimodal conversion is demanding on phones; use the smaller 0.8B or 2B options if memory or response time becomes a problem.

name: Qwen3-VL 2B Instruct
description: A small Qwen3 vision-language assistant for reading and describing images.
bestFor: Describing photos, reading visible text, and answering questions grounded in an attached image. This is the smaller Qwen3-VL instruction model; keep images and conversations modest to limit runtime memory on a phone.

name: Qwen3-VL 4B Instruct
description: A larger Qwen3 vision-language model for more involved image questions.
bestFor: Detailed image descriptions, visible-text questions, and visual reasoning with the larger Qwen3-VL assistant. Its weights and image-processing overhead make it a high-memory option; smaller vision models may be more practical.

name: Qwen2.5-VL 3B Instruct
description: A Qwen2.5 vision-language assistant for questions about photos and visible text.
bestFor: Image descriptions, visible-text questions, and instruction following with Qwen2.5-VL. Despite the 3B name, this conversion is about 3 GB and needs additional image-encoder and generation memory; it is not a lightweight vision download.

name: LFM2-VL 450M
description: A very small Liquid AI vision-language model for basic image questions.
bestFor: Basic image descriptions and simple visual questions when a small download is the priority. This compact model has limited capacity compared with larger vision assistants; avoid treating uncertain visual guesses as confirmed facts.

name: LFM2-VL 1.6B
description: A compact Liquid AI model for text conversations and understanding images.
bestFor: Questions about attached photos and lightweight text conversations using Liquid AI's original LFM2 vision model. It offers more capacity than the 450M version while still requiring memory for both image encoding and generated responses.

name: LFM2.5-VL 1.6B
description: A newer compact Liquid AI vision-language model for image and text questions.
bestFor: Text assistance and questions about attached images with the newer LFM2.5-VL conversion. Its download remains relatively compact for a vision model, but image processing can increase working memory and latency during a response.

name: Ministral 3 3B Instruct
description: Mistral AI's small multimodal assistant for text conversations and image questions.
bestFor: General instruction following, writing, and image-grounded questions using Mistral AI's smaller multimodal model. The vision encoder and generation cache add to the roughly 2.8 GB download, making this a higher-memory phone option.
